scope: Two questions were reviewed after observing reference mismatches. This is not a comprehensive reference audit and is not a new accuracy metric.

cases.issue: The reference treats the first day as the initial group and the fourth day as three tripling transitions. Reading after four days as four elapsed growth intervals gives a different initial count.
cases.primary_score_policy: Keep numeric reference 30 and retain every original response. Do not describe every answer of 10 as an arithmetic failure.

cases.issue: The reference averages the four per-tree branch-to-height ratios. A response instead divides combined branches by combined height, which is a height-weighted mean.
cases.primary_score_policy: Keep numeric reference 4. Distinguish choice of averaging convention from arithmetic error.
